newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers resist barge dip.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers resist barge dip.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were barely changed on Friday, despite a dip in the barge market, and prices elsewhere were stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were quoted at around $85/$87 fob, as on Thursday, even though barges dipped by over $1 to around $84.

Some traders said the barges traded were of stored material and the few shipowners that did want to buy requested running refinery product. Others said the isolated barge deals were trading house players.
Total ARA volume was low, under 10,000 tonnes, after a healthy day of enquiries on Thursday.
"We saw many buyers yesterday, but hardly anyone at all today," one supplier said.
Hamburg bunkers were similarly steady and subdued.
Mediterranean bunkers were also steady and most suppliers saw very low demand.
